_doc: Flat plates of the whole sheet for the live shots (scripts/final_queue.sh): straight down, orthographic, at the print resolution (4400x3400, the sheet edge to edge). sheet: the whole certificate as rendered, figures moving; figures: the figures and props alone, on transparency. ProRes 4444 with alpha. first_frame_s: the video time of the first frame (song time; there is no pre-roll), including the handle before the shot.
